pages.summary: It is a little-known fact that Monsters enjoy Spooky Season, too. But look around...you will find Undead of all kinds, and even Piglins festively dressed for the occasion.

elements.text: But be warned...The Costumes these festive fiends have donned make them formidable foes. Approach with caution.

pages.summary: Should you find yourself able to best one of these masquerading monstrosities, they may drop a piece of their costume.

elements.text: The 'costumes' are armor, diamond equivalent, at that! Collect them all, if you dare...
